explanation: Naive Bayes Sequence - This is a Machine Learning approach using a Naive Bayes classifier trained on recent sequence features, applying Laplace smoothing to estimate outcome probabilities. It operates with signal parameters such as feature_window_set=[20, 50], smoothing_alpha=1.0, prediction_threshold=0.56. To control risk, it halts trading after 3 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 8 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 3 units. It avoids trading during highly dominant one-sided market periods (anti-chop mechanism).
